name: The Outpost
description: Talon, the lone survivor of a race called the Blackbloods, sets off to the edge of civilisation to track her family's killers. On her journey she discovers she has supernatural powers which she must learn to harness in order to achieve her goals.

videos.title: One is the Loneliest Number
videos.overview: Talon, the lone survivor of the Blackblood race, seeks vengeance on the men who slaughtered her people. Her journey takes her to a desperate Outpost on the edge of the realm where she finally confronts one of the men who killed her family.

videos.title: Two Heads are Better Than None
videos.overview: From her mysterious savior, Talon learns deep secrets about herself and her kind. Meanwhile, Gate Marshall Wythers investigates the murder of a Prime Order officer, vowing to execute the killer.

videos.title: The Mistress and the Worm
videos.overview: Talon struggles to command a murderous creature she has summoned. Garret and Janzo work to uncover the cause of the plaguing disease. Talon and Gwynn’s unlikely friendship grows as Talon continues to search for more of her family’s murderers.

videos.title: Strange Bedfellows
videos.overview: Against the Smith’s advice, Talon goes after the demon before she’s ready. The Mistress proves herself a ruthless enemy in her scheme to take over the colipsum trade.

videos.title: Bones to Pick
videos.overview: Having discovered a powerful secret, Wythers blackmails Gwynn; Five killers from Talon's past look to take care of unfinished business.

videos.title: The Book of Names
videos.overview: Talon promises to find the mysterious “Book of Names.” Gwynn’s true identity is revealed. Talon agrees to escort Janzo to meet the Worm’s colipsum supplier outside the walls of the Outpost.

videos.title: The Colipsum Conundrum
videos.overview: Gwynn’s suspicions of Wyther's guilt are intensified and her decisive action strains her relationship with Garret. Talon and Janzo are faced with more questions than answers when they finally meet the elusive colipsum suppliers. Garret struggles with a new desperate secret that may kill him.

videos.title: Beyond the Wall
videos.overview: Talon, Janzo and Garret venture into forbidden territory in search of the Book of Names. An army is led to the Outpost gates.

videos.title: The Vex Rezicon
videos.overview: Talon, Garret, and Janzo are ambushed and the Book of Names falls into enemy hands. The Prime Order settles into its new oppressive rule at the Outpost. Everit Dred has Gwynn trapped, but she is instead taken captive by another threat.

videos.title: The Dragman is Coming
videos.overview: Talon, Garret, and Janzo return from the Greyskin wastelands to find the Outpost very different from how they left it. Talon faces Dred, but is torn between getting revenge and saving her friends.

videos.title: We Only Kill to Survive
videos.overview: Talon summons a new threat, recalling the ghosts of her childhood. Meanwhile, while Garret hunts for Dred, Gwynn prepares the Outpost for war. Lastly, a messenger brings devastating news.

videos.title: This Is One Strange Town
videos.overview: Talon tries to outmaneuver her new rival while Gwynn  struggles to maintain control of the Outpost. A Baron named Tobin marches in and makes an outrageous proposal. The Mistress bitterly reunites with a close relative.

videos.title: Not In My Kingdom
videos.overview: Rebb goes behind Talon’s back to offer Gwynn a powerful army. Tobin courts Gwynn but his roguish behavior gets in the way. Naya is tasked with reshaping Janzo so Talon will see him in a new light.

videos.title: Regarding the Matter of Garret Spears
videos.overview: Gwynn is taken hostage with a ransom only Talon can pay. Talon summons a risky ally to help her finish what she started. Janzo tries out his new image on Talon.

videos.title: The Blade of The Three
videos.overview: Wythers hatches a plan to save Garret before it is too late. Gwynn responds to Tobin’s proposal. Meanwhile, Talon and Zed discover a key to great power. Lastly, Garret heads out on a dark mission.

videos.title: Because She's Worth It
videos.overview: Talon and Zed leave on a quest to Talon’s childhood home. Meanwhile, Tobin proves his worth to Gwynn. Janzo experiments with plaguelings and Naya’s Prime Order connections return to haunt her.

videos.title: Where You Go, People Die
videos.overview: Zed waits for Talon after a mysterious disappearance. Tobin faces his despised cousin while Gwynn makes Tobin an offer he can't refuse. A surprise visitor to the Outpost interrupts a royal ceremony.

videos.title: A Crown for The Queen
videos.overview: Talon and Zed pursue a cold-blooded killer in a bold rescue attempt. Gwynn tasks Janzo with finding a cure for the plaguelings, as well as a delusional patient. Gwynn and Garret are reunited.

videos.title: There will be a Reckoning
videos.overview: As the Outpost is besieged, its most wanted prisoner plans an escape. Talon and Zed unearth an enemy from Talon's childhood. Milus leaves the Outpost bitterly disappointed.

videos.title: The Only Way
videos.overview: Talon and Zed unlock a power that Talon distrusts. The Mistress plots an unlikely path to victory as a deadly assassin is on the loose at the Outpost. Naya faces her old master, with startling consequences. Lastly, Garret takes on a new objective.

videos.title: Nothing Short of Heroic
videos.overview: Garret runs into Talon, now a Prime Order captive as Gwynn's lost relation has a claim to the throne. Meanwhile, Janzo becomes desperate to find a plagueling cure. Lastly, a devastating Prime Order weapon is revealed.

videos.title: In the Worst Corner of My Memory
videos.overview: Garret faces a bitter enemy while Talon fights off the Prime Order. Naya is imprisoned for her crimes as Janzo continues to come to her defense. The Mistress pieces together some very important pieces of Janzo's history. Meanwhile, the Prime Order army marches toward the Outpost.

videos.title: This Is Our Outpost
videos.overview: The Prime Order attacks the Outpost; Talon risks everything with a bold plan; Garret seeks his revenge; Gwynn must decide the fate of someone she once trusted.

videos.title: For the Sins of Your Ancestors
videos.overview: With the Outpost taken over by hostile black-bloods, Talon must band with her allies to fight back.

videos.title: The Peace You Promised
videos.overview: Wren and Janzo solve a mysterious puzzle box; Tobin and Munt escape to recruit help; Talon learns a secret about who abandoned her.

videos.title: A Life for a Life
videos.overview: Talon, Wren, Janzo and Yavalla fight to survive as they search a labyrinth for an ancient relic while Gwynn and Zed fight for control of the outpost.

videos.title: The Key to Paradise
videos.overview: As Talon presses for answers, Yavalla recruits Gwynn for her cause. Reunited with a past love, Tobin faces a difficult choice. Lastly, Zed's loyalty is tested.

videos.title: Under Yavalla's Control
videos.overview: Tobin returns to the Outpost with an army - and a secret. Talon presses for answers and a fight in the Throne Room ends in death, imprisonment and a new commander of the Outpost.

videos.title: Kill the Rat, Kill the Kinj
videos.overview: Talon sets up a sanctuary for the infected while Janzo and Wren conduct research to find a cure. Garret investigates a cult using human sacrifices.

videos.title: Go Ahead and Run
videos.overview: Yavalla, Gwynn and Tobin overtake the Capital with Talon, Garret and Zed hot on their heels. Meanwhile, the Outpost becomes a new home for a Prime Order brute.

videos.title: Dying Is Painful
videos.overview: Talon deals with difficult emotions as death seems to be the only answer to save her friends. The Outpost becomes a fight arena as an old enemy releases a dark power into unsuspecting hands.

videos.title: She Is Not A God
videos.overview: Tobin's secret is revealed to Gwynn. Talon learns of a long-lost deadly power. Meanwhile, two groups hunt for Yavalla - one group in hopes to find a cure and the other trying to kill.

videos.title: From Paradise to Hell and Back
videos.overview: Yavalla's strength is tested as Wren, her own daughter, confronts her as Janzo, Talon and Zed attempt an assassination. Meanwhile, Tobin's loyalty is questioned.

videos.title: The Hardest Part of Being Queen
videos.overview: Falista's anger is unleashed as she and Gwynn come to terms over Tobin. Meanwhile, Janzo exposes a phony cure scheme. Lastly, Talon seeks answers about her father.

videos.title: Where Death Lives
videos.overview: Talon and Zed learn painful truths about their relatives. Tobin makes a heroic rescue and Yavalla's horde grows as the Outpost prepares for battle.

videos.title: Violence Is Futile
videos.overview: The Outpost becomes overrun and Talon and Zed return with an unexpected ally. Facing total defeat, a sacrifice is seen as the only hope.

videos.title: Someone Has to Rule
videos.overview: Garret wants Talon to take the throne, while a mysterious assassin seeks revenge. Falista mourns for Tobin but hatches a new plan. Zed wants Wren to be High Priestess and uncovers a secret about her.

videos.title: A Throne of Our Own
videos.overview: Garret attacks a new queen and strange visions reveal a new threat. Janzo discovers Wren's secret.

videos.title: The Gods Thank You
videos.overview: Garret is set free but must serve a new ruler. Talon and Zed return to save the Blackbloods but discover a tragedy. Falista tries to make peace.

videos.title: Going to Meet the Gods
videos.overview: Garret leads a rebellion. Talon and Zed track a Lu-Qiri to find a new enemy. Falista recruits Wren and Janzo to serve a specific purpose. Luna faces her greatest challenge yet.

videos.title: They Bleed Black Blood
videos.overview: Talon and Luna fight to save Zed from unearthly powers. Garret pressures Tobin to betray Falista. Wren and Janzo explore mysteries beneath the Outpost. Meanwhile, the kinjes are summoned to the Capital.

videos.title: All We Do is Say Goodbye
videos.overview: Garret and Luna set out on a rescue mission. Meanwhile, Tobin proves his loyalty and Wren and Janzo discover what lies beneath the Outpost. A quest begins to uncover Luna's past.

videos.title: The Power of the Masters
videos.overview: Talon and Luna recruit an old friend to help them find an ancient key. Tobin and Falista have an extraordinary meeting. Wren and Janzo unleash a menace causing Garret and Zed to go on a hunt.

videos.title: The Pleasing Voice of the Masters
videos.overview: Talon and Luna fight against the gods but not all goes as planned. Janzo is reunited with someone from his past. Meanwhile, Garret and Janzo feud over the fate of a prisoner. Lastly, Tobin fights to save Talon.

videos.title: The Price of Immortality
videos.overview: Talon and Zed see ominous visions beneath the Outpost. Garret tests his relationship with Talon. Janzo solves the riddle of an old relic.

videos.title: Something to Live For
videos.overview: Talon and Luna return to a familiar tomb. Janzo and Wren find themselves in a precarious position. Meanwhile, Zed, Munt, and Nedra must play a deadly game against the gods.

videos.title: Guardian of the Asterkinj
videos.overview: Talon and Luna must make a very difficult choice. Meanwhile, Zed returns to the Outpost with a heavy burden.

videos.title: The Betrayer
videos.overview: Talon and Luna return to the Outpost with a dubious ally. Garret and Zed attempt to a descent on the Outpost. Meanwhile, Janzo and Wren devise a plan to save the Kahvi and Talon learns about Aster's true plan.

videos.title: Nothing Lasts Forever
videos.overview: Talon and her friends battle against the gods; Janzo, Wren, and Munt fight to save the Kahvi; and a ruler is crowned.
